description: Exercises the fleeing (0.5x) / below-25% (0.25x) / fled (1x) VP multipliers together, and a Domination figure entered by hand (75, as the scenario's own values make two quarters, one double-strength and one uncontested). strategic-locations isn't in the scenario, so strategicLocationVpTotal isn't worked out despite being non-zero. Only 1 of 3 units actually left the table (fled), so Breaking the Enemy must not trigger.
